header.sealed_rule: Admission unit index, independent of locator or diagnostic span
Zero-based preorder occurrence in declared child-field order, without interning
One after successful bounded sealing of the whole tree

fields.description: Structured parser diagnostics in source order
Count of candidate tokens consumed including EOF
Function actor or worker parameter nodes
Send stop join or assignment target
Integer decimal string keyword or heredoc category
Text segment or preserved source spelling
Whether parsing continued after this diagnostic
Import-site form names that narrow selected exposures
Declaration visibility authored by the syntax parser
Lexical binding occurrence with its own diagnostic span
Actor receive binding and per-message body
Exact literal data: numeric Int value binary64 bits UTF-8 text or hexadecimal bytes
Declared lexical literal flavor independent of spelling
Whether the lexical literal disables interpolation and cooked escapes
Common leading whitespace byte count removed at lexical admission
Admitted import path literal occurrence and decoded data
Closed exposure_kind declaration role for named bare or wildcard module exposure
How a function is defined: hey for a body written in Hey, extern for a runtime callable declared by signature
The runtime module that provides an extern function, when it is not the module that declares it
The runtime callable identity an extern function binds to, when it is not the function name
Built-in names an import's conceals clause takes out of scope
The doc comment (## lines) written directly above a declaration, joined by newlines
positional, rest, keyword or keyword_rest: how a call binds an argument to the parameter
borrow (when absent), update or consume: what an internal extern's runtime callable does with the argument
Whether an internal extern is visible bare in every program (the core builtins); every other builtin is reached through its namespace
The language operation an internal extern performs (for example place_update, place_read), or ehy_template for an Ehy template's render function, so the compiler finds it by role and never by name
The forms an exposed name is reachable in from outside its module (qualified, unqualified, dotted), as its exposes clause lists them
The infix operator spelling an exposed function claims; only an overridable infix operator can be claimed
A module path as its segments, outermost first (Shapes/Area is Shapes then Area); never joined text
The visibility tier an exposed name is limited to (package), as its exposes clause names it with `within:`; empty means visible to every importer
Whether a module path starts at the root (`::Shapes.area`), passing over any nearer module of the same name
Whether an object entry's key is an expression evaluated when the literal is built (`{[expr]: v}`), not a label or a quoted String
Warning codes a warnings declaration denies, in source order
Warning codes a warnings declaration allows, in source order
The bytes a template wrote outside its tags, exactly as written (no escape is read in them)
A template function's locals: the names its template uses and binds to nothing, each read from the `locals` parameter

nodes.description: Import declaration with literal path selector and alias occurrences
Actor initialization and per-message receive region
Function actor or worker parameter, with its default value and binding kind
Actor receive binding and per-message body
Literal with exact admitted data and diagnostic source spelling
Decoded text data or expression interpolation child
Write effect with ordered argument expressions
Named argument label with one ordered value expression child
Supervision construction with actor and restart-bound expression children
Selected import label and optional local alias occurrences
Static key data and one shorthand value occurrence
Log effect with ordered path and value expressions
Job with worker target and ordered options
Adjacent string literals in source order with one warning
Module export declaration with its closed form and ordered label occurrences
Module export label occurrence without a lexical name use
Actor await: watch I/O handles for readiness, then end the turn
Discard: call a function for its effect and drop its result (`_ = f()`)
File-level warning levels: the codes this file denies (errors) and allows (silent), over the command line
Template text: the bytes a template wrote outside its tags, appended to the rendered output as written
Template output tag (the user's <%= %>): the text of its expression, appended to the rendered output
